verdict.rationale: LegalOS runs dedicated startup and enterprise programs. Its enterprise page gives People, Operations, Finance and hiring teams attorney guidance before a hire, with "case visibility within one accountable immigration team." Employer-sponsored workflows cover H-1B (including transfers and extensions), O-1, TN and L-1, so a growing team can run beyond single founder cases through one provider. Missing for 10: an explicit multi-case dashboard or portfolio view across employees, volume or team pricing details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of managing multiple concurrent cases.
